violations.why: writer1_isr (prio 4) can preempt closer1_isr (prio 2) between the two reads in JudgeCondi.
closer3_isr (prio 4) preempts writer3_isr (prio 1) after it writes array[TRIGGER] and overwrites it before the read.
writer1_isr preempts closer1_isr and resets expect_close, so the check at 1017 sees 0 rather than 42.
writer1_isr preempts closer2_isr and overwrites expect_close before it is read.
writer1_isr sets count=0 between closer1_isr's write of 1 and its read.
writer1_isr preempts closer2_isr between its write and read of count.
closer1_isr (prio 2) preempts writer3_isr (prio 1) and sets count=1 before writer3_isr reads it.
